label: Add to 10
description: Compute 10 + b for a single-digit b (e.g. 10 + 3 -> 13). Treated as its own, more primitive leaf skill rather than an instance of the general skill.add_to(N) family -- adding onto a round base like 10 is developmentally more direct (it maps straight onto the tens-and-ones naming, 'ten-three'), and it is exactly the component strategy.make_ten needs, not the general single-digit + single-digit skill it is used to build.
source: Carpenter, Fennema, Franke, Levi & Empson, Children's Mathematics: Cognitively Guided Instruction (2nd ed., 2014)
